skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the necessity of state intervention through policy, distinguish between policy and other management tools of the state.
Understand the stages of the policy development process, identify the role and position of each stage within the policy process.
Analyze the current economic-social conditions of Vietnam to determine policy issues.
Analyze the current methods of organizing policy implementation in Vietnam.
Analyze the current economic-social conditions of Vietnam to evaluate ongoing policies.
Practice reading, writing, and presentation skills.
Develop creative thinking and independent opinion.
Develop ethical awareness and social responsibility.
